💡 This mini-review uniquely frames silicon-deposited porous carbon (SiDPC) as a distinct structural paradigm beyond blended Si–C composites, emphasizing its evolution from passive buffering to active structural regulation. item.title: Near-Theoretical-Density Zinc Plating Enabled by an Ordered Janus Interphase for High-Energy Zinc Pouch Cells
item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is a nanometer-thin organic–inorganic Janus bilayer (CF-LaF3) that pre-engineers the zinc interface, combining desolvation, water blocking, and uniform Zn2+ flux. It enables near-theoretical-density plating (8.60 vs 8.54 μm) at 5 mAh cm–2, dendrite-free, and 109 Wh L–1 Ah-level Zn||I2 pouch cells, offering a scalable route to practical high-energy aqueous zinc batteries.
